answers.label: Comments on opposition to QC4
answers.text: MB instruments are simply a signal to the market that decarbonization has value, as the purchaser can't decarbonize easily other ways. An extensive amount of effort to match that hour by hour doesn't really add value or change the trajectory of decision-making, from what we can see. Companies and grids need to become lower carbon, period, and that should be the real focus around any MB improvements, driving more efficiency, more investment in renewables, and retirement of the most carbon-intensive plants.
